Based on the visual evidence in the image:

(1) The orange route line is **disconnected**. There is a clear gap between the end of the solid L-shaped line and the beginning of the dashed, wavy curve section.

(2) The small circular handles are **floating far from the solid orange line**. They appear to be positioned along the path of the dashed wavy curve, which is offset from the main solid route line.
